parsed.rationale: Localized contact dermatitis from known poison ivy exposure on forearms, no fever, no breathing difficulty, no facial/genital/widespread involvement or signs of infection reported; supportive care (cool compresses, calamine, OTC hydrocortisone, oral antihistamine) is appropriate. Seek care if rash spreads to face/eyes/genitals, becomes widespread, shows pus/increasing pain, or persists beyond 2-3 weeks.
